section.title: Spring Boot — All Annotations
section.subtitle: Every major Spring Boot annotation with examples, plus Django/DRF equivalents.

topics.title: Core Annotations — @SpringBootApplication, @Configuration, @Bean, @Component, @Autowired
topics.learn: The foundation annotations every Spring app uses.

python.definition: Django equivalent: INSTALLED_APPS registers apps; AppConfig.ready() = @PostConstruct; decorators like @login_required = @PreAuthorize. No DI annotations — Django uses explicit imports.
python.code:
# settings.py — register apps
INSTALLED_APPS = [
    'django.contrib.admin',
    'myapp',
]

# apps.py — app config (like @Configuration)
class MyAppConfig(AppConfig):
    name = 'myapp'
    def ready(self): ...   # ~ @PostConstruct

# No @Autowired — import classes directly
from myapp.services import UserService

java.definition: @SpringBootApplication = @Configuration + @EnableAutoConfiguration + @ComponentScan (one annotation does it all). @Configuration marks config class; @Bean defines a bean; @Component/@Service/@Repository = stereotype annotations for auto-detection; @Autowired injects dependencies.

python.definition: Django: path() in urls.py maps URLs to views; request.GET/POST access params; JsonResponse/request.data for body. DRF: @api_view, @action decorators.
python.code:
# urls.py
path("students/<int:id>/", views.detail),
path("students/", views.list),

# views.py — FBV
def detail(request, id):
    # id = path param
    # request.GET.get('q') = query param
    # request.data = JSON body
    return JsonResponse({})

# DRF CBV
class StudentViewSet(viewsets.ModelViewSet):
    queryset = Student.objects.all()
    serializer_class = StudentSerializer

java.definition: @RestController = @Controller + @ResponseBody (auto JSON). @RequestMapping base path; @GetMapping/@PostMapping/@PutMapping/@DeleteMapping/@PatchMapping for verbs. @PathVariable = URL param, @RequestParam = query param, @RequestBody = JSON body.

python.definition: Django models: class Meta for table name, field classes for columns, ForeignKey/OneToOneField/ManyToManyField for relationships. No annotations — class-based DSL.
python.code:
class Student(models.Model):
    name = models.CharField(max_length=100)   # column
    age = models.IntegerField()

    class Meta:
        db_table = 'students'      # = @Table(name=...)
        ordering = ['name']

# Relationships:
course = models.ForeignKey(Course)     # = @ManyToOne
profile = models.OneToOneField(User)       # = @OneToOne
tags = models.ManyToManyField(Tag)          # = @ManyToMany

# Transactions: @transaction.atomic
from django.db import transaction
with transaction.atomic():
    obj.save()

java.definition: @Entity = table, @Table(name) = table name, @Id = primary key, @GeneratedValue = auto ID, @Column = column config. Relationships: @ManyToOne/@OneToMany/@OneToOne/@ManyToMany. @Transactional = transaction boundary.

topics.title: Validation & Exception Annotations — @Valid, @NotNull, @Min, @ExceptionHandler, @ControllerAdvice
topics.learn: Input validation and global error handling.

python.definition: Django forms validate via field classes (EmailField, MinValueValidator). DRF serializers validate via field types + validators. Custom errors via ValidationError.
python.code:
# Django forms
class StudentForm(forms.Form):
    name = forms.CharField(max_length=100)
    age = forms.IntegerField(min_value=0)
    email = forms.EmailField()

# DRF serializer validation
class StudentSerializer(serializers.Serializer):
    name = serializers.CharField(max_length=100)
    age = serializers.IntegerField(min_value=0, max_value=120)
    email = serializers.EmailField()

# Custom exception handler
@api_view(['POST'])
def create(request):
    s = StudentSerializer(data=request.data)
    s.is_valid(raise_exception=True)  # auto 400

java.definition: Bean Validation annotations on DTO fields + @Valid on controller params triggers validation. @ControllerAdvice + @ExceptionHandler = global exception handling for all controllers.

topics.title: AOP Annotations — @Aspect, @Before, @After, @Around, @Pointcut
topics.learn: Aspect-Oriented Programming — cross-cutting concerns (logging, timing, security).

python.definition: Python equivalent = decorators! Decorators wrap functions to add behaviour (logging, timing, auth) without modifying the function — same concept as AOP.

java.definition: @Aspect marks aspect class; @Pointcut defines WHERE to apply; @Before/@After/@AfterReturning/@AfterThrowing/@Around = WHEN relative to method execution. Spring AOP uses proxies.

python.definition: APScheduler or Celery for scheduled tasks. Django settings.py / environment variables for config. python-decouple for .env files.
python.code:
# Celery beat for scheduled tasks
from celery import Celery
app = Celery('tasks')

@app.task
def send_email(): ...

# Schedule in celery beat config:
# 'send-daily': {'task': 'tasks.send_email', 'schedule': crontab(hour=9)}

# Config via environment
import os
DEBUG = os.getenv('DEBUG', 'False') == 'True'
DATABASE_URL = os.getenv('DATABASE_URL')

java.definition: @EnableScheduling + @Scheduled(cron/fixedRate/fixedDelay) for tasks. @Profile activates beans per environment. @ConfigurationProperties binds application.properties/yml to a class. @Value injects single property.

python.definition: DRF: permission_classes=[IsAdminUser, IsAuthenticated]. Django: @login_required, @permission_required('app.perm'). Custom: BasePermission subclass.

java.definition: @EnableMethodSecurity enables annotation-based auth. @PreAuthorize = most powerful (SpEL expressions). @Secured = role check. @RolesAllowed = JSR-250 standard. Combine with Spring Security config.

topics.title: Testing Annotations — @SpringBootTest, @WebMvcTest, @DataJpaTest, @MockBean
topics.learn: Spring Boot test slices and mocking.

python.definition: pytest + pytest-django: @pytest.mark.django_db for DB access, @pytest.fixture for setup, unittest.mock.patch for mocking. DRF: APIClient for endpoint tests.

java.definition: @SpringBootTest = full context integration test. @WebMvcTest = only web layer (controllers). @DataJpaTest = only JPA/repositories. @MockBean/@MockitoBean = mock a bean. @Autowired injects test dependencies.

python.definition: Django/Python equivalents: ordering via list position, lazy via import inside function, conditional via settings flag, primary via direct import.

java.definition: @Order sets bean/method priority. @Conditional creates bean only if condition met. @Lazy delays bean creation. @Primary marks preferred bean when multiple exist. @Qualifier selects specific bean. @PostConstruct/@PreDestroy = init/destroy callbacks.
